title: Symbiosis — A Manual for a Good Lineage / Simbiosis — Manual para un buen linaje (v2.0)
description:
A manual for the human side of working with AI: how a person, without programming, builds outside the machine the memory it lacks (a small folder of notes the model reads before working and updates after), and climbs four steps — lineage, memory, judgment, automation — earning autonomy in blocks with green, yellow and red risk zones. One text for two readers: the person and their machine. Spanish original and English translation.

Un manual para el lado humano de trabajar con una IA. Original en español y traducción al inglés.
